run_pipeline_augment_dataset: run a pipeline to augment a HuggingFace dataset with LLM-generated columns and push to hub
build_dependency_graph_columns: build a dependency graph for columns that reference other columns in the generation config
generate_completion_inference_client: generate a completion using HuggingFace InferenceClient with retry logic and exponential backoff
process_node_parallel_pipeline: process a node in the parallel pipeline by resolving dependencies and generating LLM output
load_config_yaml_source: load a YAML configuration from a local file or remote URL for the pipeline
